Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances, written by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token decimals value, set in ERC20 constructor and _setupDecimals.
Constant uint8 DECIMALS = 18 used to compute the initial supply.
Constant uint256 initial supply = 100000000000000 * 10**18.
BabyDoge constructor that mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender.

Public approve entry point; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.

Internal mint routine; increases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
Internal burn routine; decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance writer; sets _allowances[owner][spender].
Public burn; burns _msgSender() balance via _burn.
Public burnFrom; reduces allowance then burns account balance.
Caller address, obtained via _msgSender(), used as transfer/approve/burn initiator and mint recipient.
Direct state mutation of _balances inside _transfer without reentrancy guards.
Supply and balance mutation performed inside _mint.
Supply and balance mutation performed inside _burn.

edges.reason: BabyDoge constructor reads msg.sender to receive the entire INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor execution is controlled by the deployer identified through msg.sender.
Constructor calls internal _mint to create the initial supply.
ERC20.transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom invokes _transfer to move tokens.
ERC20.transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
ERC20.approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
ERC20.increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
ERC20Burnable.burn calls _burn on the caller balance.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom calls _approve to store the reduced allowance.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom calls _burn to destroy tokens.
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of _transfer inside ERC20.transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner in ERC20.approve/_approve.
msg.sender is the account burned by ERC20Burnable.burn.
msg.sender is used as spender/allowance owner in ERC20Burnable.burnFrom.
_transfer mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer performs the unguarded balance state write captured by the unsafe operation node.
Unsafe operation updates the _balances mapping state.
_mint increases _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint performs the supply/balance mutation captured as an unsafe operation.
Mint unsafe operation writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn decreases _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn performs the supply/balance destruction captured as an unsafe operation.
Burn unsafe operation writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
recipient parameter is consumed by ERC20.transfer.
amount parameter is consumed by ERC20.transfer.
sender parameter feeds the balance subtraction in _transfer.
amount parameter feeds the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
decreasedAllowance local is stored by ERC20Burnable.burnFrom.
amount parameter is passed to _burn by ERC20Burnable.burn.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter of transfer is only meaningful as an argument of ERC20.transfer, so it collapses into that core function node.
amount parameter of transfer has no independent behaviour and is subsumed by ERC20.transfer.
sender parameter of _transfer is a purely local argument and merges into the ERC20._transfer core function.
amount parameter of _transfer only participates in its balance arithmetic and merges into ERC20._transfer.
decreasedAllowance is a temporary computed only inside ERC20Burnable.burnFrom and merges into that function.
amount parameter of burn is only used to call _burn and merges into ERC20Burnable.burn.
